requirements.requirement: Identify a person who is the founder of a company whose online video games division released a video game in a specific year between 2000 and 2010, both years inclusive, and that video game, at least until 2019, was considered one of the top-earning games of all time.
Establish that this person graduated from a university founded between 1930 and 1970, both years inclusive.
Establish that this person has a spouse and that, up to 2019, the spouse had no children from the marriage.
Establish that this person and their spouse made a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex.
Establish that, as of 2019, this building was scheduled to open sometime between 2018 and 2021, both years inclusive, and was part of a specific university.
Determine which university this building was a part of as of 2023.
